title: Draft PR on failed/unconverged run + convergence state in body
goal: When the pipeline status is `failed` or the build cycle ends at `max_iterations`, open the PR as a draft and include the cycle's convergence state (iterations used, failing gates) in the PR body; passing/converged runs remain non-draft.

steps.description: Add regression tests (red on main) covering: (1) pipeline status `failed` → draft PR; (2) `max_iterations` cycle → draft PR; (3) PR body contains convergence block with iterations and failing gate names. Tests call `_pr_open_run_inner` with fixture state files that reproduce each scenario and assert the draft flag and body content.

In `_pr_open_run_inner`: (a) after resolving `_draft_bool` from `_TPL_PR_DRAFT`, read pipeline `.status` and `.cycle_iterations` from `state_file`; (b) read `gate_aggregator_result` path from `ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS`; (c) force `_draft_bool=true` when `.status == failed` OR any `cycle_iterations[*].status == max_iterations`; (d) derive `_convergence_info` (cycle_id, current_iter, max_iter, failing gates array) and pass it to `_pr_open_compose_body` as a new argument.

In `_pr_open_compose_body` (advisory-section.sh): (a) accept new `convergence_info` JSON argument; (b) render a convergence block when non-empty — `> ⚠️ **<cycle_id> did not converge** (N/M iterations). Failing gates: <names>. Opened under ADR-019 fall-through…`; (c) always show iterations-used/max for any cycle that ran (even converged), so the body always states the cycle's convergence state per the acceptance criteria.

Add `gate_aggregator_result` as an optional input to the pr-open manifest (ADR-055 §1: declared inputs reach the plugin through the engine's index). This wires the input declaration to match what the code now reads from `ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS`.

notes: 1. The gate_aggregator_result path is already available in ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS when pr-open runs inside pr-delivery (shared process, pr-delivery declares the input). Adding it to pr-open's own manifest satisfies ADR-055 §1 without requiring new plumbing. 2. Convergence detection scans ALL keys in `.cycle_iterations` for any with `status == max_iterations` — not just `build_test_cycle` — so the fix is general. 3. The PR body must show the convergence state for ALL cycles that ran, not just unconverged ones (acceptance criterion: 'body shows the cycle's iterations used out of the maximum'). For converged cycles this is informational; for unconverged it is the prominent warning. 4. When an existing PR is updated via `gh pr edit`, `--draft` cannot be set after create; `gh pr ready --undo` would be needed to convert an existing non-draft to draft. The plan must handle the update-existing-PR path: if the PR already exists and should be draft, call `gh pr ready <num> --undo` (converts to draft). This is a subtle edge case not called out in the issue but required for correctness — added as a note; if gh CLI version does not support `--undo`, the step should emit a warning rather than failing. 5. The `_draft_bool` variable is also used in pr-result.json; once forced to `true` it should flow through correctly into the recorded artifact. 6. Tests must confirm they are red on main by asserting draft=true in pr-result.json; the current code always writes `_draft_bool` from `_TPL_PR_DRAFT` only, so these assertions will fail against main.
